mstts:express-as.prosody: Imagine a place where every move you make is watched, every word you speak is weighed, and just a hint of doubt could change your life forever. North Korea is a world wrapped in secrecy and fear—a society so tightly controlled that truth itself feels like something rare, almost forbidden. Inside its borders, people live under a relentless cult of personality, where loyalty is everything and suspicion seems to grow in every shadow. Now, what if you could step inside that world—not just as an outsider looking in, but through the eyes of someone who once belonged to the regime’s inner circle? That’s exactly what we’ll do together as we explore Dear Leader: Poet, Spy, Escapee – A Look Inside North Korea, written by Jang Jin-sung. His journey takes us from the privileged heights of being a favored poet, all the way to the perilous path of a hunted defector. Along the way, we’ll see how the regime’s grip doesn’t just control actions, but reaches deep into the minds and hearts of its people—turning neighbors into informants, and making even the simplest act of independent thought a risky gamble. But here’s what’s truly remarkable: despite the suffocating atmosphere, we’ll also discover the quiet sparks of resistance and the strength it takes just to hold onto your own sense of self. So, welcome to this journey. Let’s peel back the layers of secrecy together, uncover what daily life is really like under dictatorship, and find out what it means to survive—and even hope—when trust is a luxury you can’t afford.
